meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth, including Tip: lines in the TUI. Use when the user asks about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips they can see.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 看懂工具里的每条提示,弄清它到底能做什么
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果看到工具里的提示却不知道它具体指什么。
copy.tagline_en: Understand what each in-tool tip actually does before you rely on it
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you spot a tip while using the tool and want to know what it really does.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先查当前实际的 tip 列表、读你的 settings.json,再读对应功能源码,然后用你提问时的语言把这条 tip 的底层机制讲清楚,并说明你本人能看到哪些 tip。
howto.when: 当你问某条 tip 是什么意思、某个被提示的功能怎么工作,或想知道自己能看到哪些 tip 时触发。

say.text: 刚才那行 Tip: 是什么意思?
say.note: 会查 tip 列表和源码后从机制层面讲清。

say.text: 我这边实际能看到哪些 tip?
say.note: 会读你的 settings 和 tips 历史来回答。

say.text: Fable 5 被拒后那条提示背后是什么流程?
say.note: 会从拒答检测讲到可见提示的完整链路。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude looks up the live tip list, reads your settings.json, then reads the feature's source code before answering. It explains any senpi tip in depth, in the language you asked in, and says which tips you personally can see.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips you can see. It matches your tip against the live catalog by id or by text fragment.

say_en.text: What did that Tip: line mean?
say_en.note: Looks up the tip list and source, then explains the mechanism.

say_en.text: Which tips can I actually see?
say_en.note: Reads your settings and tips history to answer.

say_en.text: What happens behind the tip after a Fable 5 refusal?
say_en.note: Walks from refusal detection to the visible tip.
